PACKAGING REQUIREMENTS | Vulnerable Clients | All vulnerable clients must have a note on the file detailing conditions and possible implications for application if any.  Any clients who have suffered domestic abuse or any other circumstances you deem necessary, MUST be made aware that through an IVA their name and address appears on the insolvency register

Minimum DI | £110 (must re-pay over £6600 during term) | 1st Payment Required | Client will be required to make their first payment is the same calendar month as the approval. Any later than 6 weeks after the Approval Date will result in the case being in breach.
Minimum Debt Level | £7000 | Previous Addresses | We MUST obtain 5 years address history - we need dates of when the client was in each address - this should be left in the notes

Bank Statements | 3 continuous full month as a minimum, Income and expenditure should correspond with the I & E or be explained in case notes (must show clients name and address) | Dependants / Children | We required dates of births of ALL children including those not living in the property with the client, as well as % of time with child i.e. 25%, 50% etc
Universal Credit | Breakdown of the what is included is required | Universal Credit Advance | MUST be entered as a debt and any deduction amount added back on to the income on the I&E

Gambling | GAMSTOP required for any cases where the amount exceeds the monthly IVA contribution. | Social Fund / Budget Loans | CANNOT be added in as a debt. We need how much outstanding, how much is being deducted if any.

Proof of all income | At least 1 wage slip dates within the last 3 months/benefit letter/bank statement/evidence of board/CSA/Full Tax Return (not the calculation)
£1000 minimum income. | Fines | We can include certain fines but nothing criminal, e.g. TV Licence fine or Speeding fine. For any fines not being included we must know the repayment amount for the I&E and the term of the repayment plan

Housing benefit income | We need evidence of the actual rental and benefit amounts or confirmation that payments are up to date. | Previous Debt Solutions | This must be checked as we need to inform the creditors of this and can be a good justification for proceeding with the IVA- if previous IVA terminated need termination docs

Partner's income | Proof of Partner income required | Budget Building | If you include Dentist, Prescriptions, Life Insurance or Building & Contents Insurance, there must be detailed notes regarding what these are for. If all 4 are added to the I&E then Watch will request an uplift from one of the areas(watch will not allow white goods insurance)

HP Agreement | Credit Search can be used as evidence (if a 3rd party is paying the HP for the client further evidence will be required) | Guarantor Debts | Client MUST be advised that the guarantor will be chased for the debt

Evidence of outgoings | Costs including rent/mortgage/secured loan payments/childcare/CSA – evidence must support the amounts placed in the I & E, if different this should be explained in a case note

For rent/board evidence, example are of this are:

•	Bank transactions 
•	Tenancy agreement
•	3 way call stating rent amount, and if any arrears, arrangement and amount, Step?
•	Email from landlord or estate agent
•	Evidence if living with family of board is higher than £350 | Joint Debts | Client MUST be advised that the other person will be chased for the debt, If this is the clients partner they live with, have you allowed money in the income and expenditure for their debts?

Evidence of Debts | If any debts are not on the Credit Search, Proof of Debts must be on file to confirm the client is still liable for the debt (including HMRC, council tax, pay day loans, credit unions, student loans, EDL, rent arrears, CCJs or fines) | Partner Expense Allowance | Partners allowance is proportionate to the % of the household income, eg partner has 50% of the household income then the partner should be allocated 50% of the household DI - Please us calculator for WATCH
Evidence of Childcare Vouchers | If client is in receipt of Tax Free childcare vouchers these are required to draft via voucher or payslip (showing payment)

Private Debt / Non Common Creditors | We require full contact details for these debts - Name, Full Address, Email & Mobile. | Dependents / Children turning 18 during IVA | If client recieves any benefits, this may stop or reduce when dependent turns 18. We have to ask the client what they plan on doing or how they propose to still afford the IVA if that were to happen

Council Tax Debt | All previous years must be included, if the client's 'Right to Pay' has been revoked for the current year this must be included as a debt also. (For the I&E, the council tax expense should be listed as normal, clients IVA payment will be the DI plus the council tax expense until April, this will then reduce down to the proposed DI) | Rent Arrears (current property) | This may be included in the IVA, as long as the landlord/agent has confirmed the current tenancy will not be effected. (If this cannot be included in the IVA, we need proof of how much is outstanding and how much the client is paying towards it each month, A step up will be implemented for this)

Assets (Property, Vehicles, Livestock etc) | All assets must be evidenced including the valuation obtained and the clients intention explained, eg retain/exclude/sell | Council Tax Arrears | We must include all previous years council tax debts (Current year dependent on circumstances will be dealt with at verification)

HMRC Majority | Any INTERLOCKING IVA with a JOINT HMRC MAJORITY debt must be referred as 2 SOLE IVA'S, HMRC will reject all interlocking IVA's where there is a joint debt | Councils and Credit Unions with an AOE | These are difficult to get approved as the creditor is receiving 100p in the £ back through the AOE

Student Income | If the client has student income, at least one third of this should be offset for books etc ***IF WATCH ON CASE STUDENT LOANS MUST BE FULLY OFFSET - BURSARY AND GRANT CAN BE USED AS INCOME BUT NEEDS TO BE NOTED AND PROOF ATTACHED*** | Sole I&E's for Joint Household | The client must NOT be married, have dependents or have any joint assets
What is the full rent/council tax/, utility bills? Does the client pay half, do we have evidence of this? We cannot have our client paying 100% of the essential expenditure costs.
Partner must be aware that they will still be liable for joint bills

Guardianship / Foster Allowance | This is classed as an income and cannot be offset | Disability Benefits | Must discolse who receives this.  DLA needs to be fully offset for children and PIP must be minimum 50% offset

Minimum DI | £110 (must re-pay over £6600 during term) | 1st Payment Required | Client will be required to make their first payment is the same calendar month as the approval. Any later than 6 weeks after the Approval Date will result in the case being in breach.
Minimum Debt Level | £7000 | Previous Addresses | We MUST obtain 5 years address history - we need dates of when the client was in each address - this should be left in the notes

Bank Statements | 3 continuous full month as a minimum, Income and expenditure should correspond with the I & E or be explained in case notes (must show clients name and address) | Dependants / Children | We required dates of births of ALL children including those not living in the property with the client, as well as % of time with child i.e. 25%, 50% etc
Universal Credit | Breakdown of the what is included is required | Universal Credit Advance | MUST be entered as a debt and any deduction amount added back on to the income on the I&E

Gambling | GAMSTOP required for any cases where the amount exceeds the monthly IVA contribution. | Social Fund / Budget Loans | CANNOT be added in as a debt. We need how much outstanding, how much is being deducted if any.

Proof of all income | At least 1 wage slip dates within the last 3 months/benefit letter/bank statement/evidence of board/CSA/Full Tax Return (not the calculation)
£1000 minimum income. | Fines | We can include certain fines but nothing criminal, e.g. TV Licence fine or Speeding fine. For any fines not being included we must know the repayment amount for the I&E and the term of the repayment plan

Housing benefit income | We need evidence of the actual rental and benefit amounts or confirmation that payments are up to date. | Previous Debt Solutions | This must be checked as we need to inform the creditors of this and can be a good justification for proceeding with the IVA- if previous IVA terminated need termination docs

Partner's income | Proof of Partner income required | Budget Building | If you include Dentist, Prescriptions, Life Insurance or Building & Contents Insurance, there must be detailed notes regarding what these are for. If all 4 are added to the I&E then Watch will request an uplift from one of the areas(watch will not allow white goods insurance)

HP Agreement | Credit Search can be used as evidence (if a 3rd party is paying the HP for the client further evidence will be required) | Guarantor Debts | Client MUST be advised that the guarantor will be chased for the debt

Evidence of outgoings | Costs including rent/mortgage/secured loan payments/childcare/CSA – evidence must support the amounts placed in the I & E, if different this should be explained in a case note

For rent/board evidence, example are of this are:

•	Bank transactions 
•	Tenancy agreement
•	3 way call stating rent amount, and if any arrears, arrangement and amount, Step?
•	Email from landlord or estate agent
•	Evidence if living with family of board is higher than £350 | Joint Debts | Client MUST be advised that the other person will be chased for the debt, If this is the clients partner they live with, have you allowed money in the income and expenditure for their debts?

Evidence of Debts | If any debts are not on the Credit Search, Proof of Debts must be on file to confirm the client is still liable for the debt (including HMRC, council tax, pay day loans, credit unions, student loans, EDL, rent arrears, CCJs or fines) | Partner Expense Allowance | Partners allowance is proportionate to the % of the household income, eg partner has 50% of the household income then the partner should be allocated 50% of the household DI - Please us calculator for WATCH
Evidence of Childcare Vouchers | If client is in receipt of Tax Free childcare vouchers these are required to draft via voucher or payslip (showing payment)

Private Debt / Non Common Creditors | We require full contact details for these debts - Name, Full Address, Email & Mobile. | Dependents / Children turning 18 during IVA | If client recieves any benefits, this may stop or reduce when dependent turns 18. We have to ask the client what they plan on doing or how they propose to still afford the IVA if that were to happen

Council Tax Debt | All previous years must be included, if the client's 'Right to Pay' has been revoked for the current year this must be included as a debt also. (For the I&E, the council tax expense should be listed as normal, clients IVA payment will be the DI plus the council tax expense until April, this will then reduce down to the proposed DI) | Rent Arrears (current property) | This may be included in the IVA, as long as the landlord/agent has confirmed the current tenancy will not be effected. (If this cannot be included in the IVA, we need proof of how much is outstanding and how much the client is paying towards it each month, A step up will be implemented for this)

Assets (Property, Vehicles, Livestock etc) | All assets must be evidenced including the valuation obtained and the clients intention explained, eg retain/exclude/sell | Council Tax Arrears | We must include all previous years council tax debts (Current year dependent on circumstances will be dealt with at verification)

HMRC Majority | Any INTERLOCKING IVA with a JOINT HMRC MAJORITY debt must be referred as 2 SOLE IVA'S, HMRC will reject all interlocking IVA's where there is a joint debt | Councils and Credit Unions with an AOE | These are difficult to get approved as the creditor is receiving 100p in the £ back through the AOE

Student Income | If the client has student income, at least one third of this should be offset for books etc ***IF WATCH ON CASE STUDENT LOANS MUST BE FULLY OFFSET - BURSARY AND GRANT CAN BE USED AS INCOME BUT NEEDS TO BE NOTED AND PROOF ATTACHED*** | Sole I&E's for Joint Household | The client must NOT be married, have dependents or have any joint assets
What is the full rent/council tax/, utility bills? Does the client pay half, do we have evidence of this? We cannot have our client paying 100% of the essential expenditure costs.
Partner must be aware that they will still be liable for joint bills

Guardianship / Foster Allowance | This is classed as an income and cannot be offset | Disability Benefits | Must discolse who receives this.  DLA needs to be fully offset for children and PIP must be minimum 50% offset

SELF EMPLOYED CASES - CRITERIA AND REQUIREMENTS
If turnover is £85,000 or over, they must be VAT registered which means they will have a VAT debt which is preferential - in this instance we cannot take the case
Must be making a profit
Must not have employees
Must have been trading for at least 6 months
Must not be a partnership
Tax Returns must be up to date
Tax Return for previous years must have been submitted to HMRC
If the Tax Return is not an accurate reflection of the clients current income, 6 months bank statements must be used to evidence the cashflow

Self-employed less than 1 year - Clients must have been trading for a minimum of 6 months. Require 6 months bank statements, invoices, and complete income breakdown spreadsheet. (Speadsheet listing all business incomings and outgoings to show how the income has been calculated however still need to supply tax return for previous years)

Self employed over 1 year - Latest Tax Return and 3 months business bank statements. If client does not have a business account, then 3 months personal accounts and complete income breakdown spreadsheet. (Speadsheet listing all business incomings and outgoings to show how the income has been calculated however still need to supply tax return for previous years)
Call recording/ live chat to confirm full HMRC balance going back 10 years
If client is a director we require the above for the client AND the business
Evidence of expenditure
Evidence of any increase in trading forecast on bank statements (increased income or reduced expenditure)
Handwritten invoices or self-typed expenses cannot be used as evidence
